# Overview

Methods 2.9.4 / Results 3.4.

1. Memory sub-sample: exclude CS = 0 or CR < 1/6 (mean across difficulty).
2. **Table 3** — CS and CR by group: Welch t if Shapiro-Wilk p > .05 in both
   groups, otherwise Mann-Whitney U; BH-FDR across the two outcomes.
3. **Table S3 / Figure S3** — within each group, CS and CR regressed on the
   within-group z-scored brain score of each LV in `params$memory_lvs` (LV2);
   BH-FDR across all regressions.

```{r load-packages}
pacman::p_load(here, tidyverse, broom, effsize, flextable, officer, knitr)
```

# 1. Memory sub-sample

```{r load-data}
pls_results <- readRDS(cleaning_path(params$run_label, "pls_results.rds"))
groups      <- levels(pls_results$pls_df$group_var)

analysis_df <- pls_results$pls_df %>%
  mutate(cs_rate_mean = rowMeans(across(all_of(params$cs_vars)), na.rm = TRUE),
         cr_rate_mean = rowMeans(across(all_of(params$cr_vars)), na.rm = TRUE))

cr_chance <- 1/6
excluded <- analysis_df %>%
  filter(cs_rate_mean == 0 | cr_rate_mean < cr_chance) %>%
  mutate(reason = case_when(cs_rate_mean == 0 & cr_rate_mean < cr_chance ~ "CS=0 & CR<1/6",
                            cs_rate_mean == 0 ~ "CS=0", TRUE ~ "CR<1/6")) %>%
  select(id, group_var, cs_rate_mean, cr_rate_mean, reason)
print(excluded)
write_csv(excluded, shared_output_path("qc", "memory_exclusions.csv"))

memory_df <- analysis_df %>% filter(!id %in% excluded$id)
cat(sprintf("Memory sub-sample: N = %d\n", nrow(memory_df)))
print(table(memory_df$group_var))
```

# 2. Table 3 — memory performance by group

```{r table4}
outcomes <- c(cs_rate_mean = "Correct Source (CS)", cr_rate_mean = "Correct Rejection (CR)")

mem_tests <- map_dfr(names(outcomes), function(v) {
  res <- run_cont_test(v, memory_df, alpha = params$alpha)
  desc <- memory_df %>% group_by(group_var) %>%
    summarise(cell = sprintf("%.3f (%.3f)", mean(.data[[v]], na.rm = TRUE),
                             sd(.data[[v]], na.rm = TRUE)), .groups = "drop")
  res %>% mutate(
    Outcome   = outcomes[[v]],
    Pre       = desc$cell[desc$group_var == groups[1]],
    Post      = desc$cell[desc$group_var == groups[2]],
    Statistic = if (test == "t-test") sprintf("t(%.1f) = %.2f", df, statistic)
                else sprintf("U = %.0f", statistic),
    ES        = if (test == "t-test") sprintf("d = %.2f", effect_size)
                else sprintf("r = %.2f", effect_size))
}) %>%
  mutate(p_fdr = p.adjust(p_value, method = params$correction_method))

table4 <- mem_tests %>% transmute(Outcome, Pre, Post, Statistic, p_FDR = format_pval(p_fdr), ES)
n_pre  <- sum(memory_df$group_var == groups[1])
n_post <- sum(memory_df$group_var == groups[2])

ft4 <- flextable(table4) %>%
  set_header_labels(Pre = "Premenopausal\nM (SD)", Post = "Postmenopausal\nM (SD)",
                    p_FDR = "p_FDR", ES = "Effect size") %>%
  add_header_row(values = c("", "Reproductive-stage group", "Unadjusted group comparison"),
                 colwidths = c(1, 2, 3)) %>%
  align(align = "center", part = "header") %>%
  align(j = "Outcome", align = "left", part = "all") %>%
  align(j = 2:6, align = "center", part = "body") %>%
  bold(part = "header") %>%
  fontsize(size = 11, part = "all") %>% font(fontname = "Times New Roman", part = "all") %>%
  hline_top(border = fp_border(width = 2), part = "header") %>%
  hline_bottom(border = fp_border(width = 2), part = "body") %>%
  autofit() %>%
  set_caption("Table 3. Memory Task Performance by Reproductive-Stage Group") %>%
  add_footer_lines(paste0(
    sprintf("Note. N = %d (premenopausal = %d, postmenopausal = %d) after exclusion of ",
            nrow(memory_df), n_pre, n_post),
    "participants failing memory-completeness criteria (CS = 0 or CR < 1/6). Values are mean ",
    "accuracy rate (SD). Unadjusted test: Mann-Whitney U if any reproductive-stage group is ",
    "non-Gaussian (Shapiro-Wilk p < .05), Welch t otherwise. Effect size: rank-biserial r for U, ",
    "Cohen's d for t (signed premenopausal minus postmenopausal). p_FDR: Benjamini-Hochberg ",
    "correction across two outcomes (CS, CR).")) %>%
  italic(part = "footer") %>% fontsize(size = 10, part = "footer")

ft4
save_as_docx(ft4, path = ms_path("Table3_memory_performance.docx"))
write_csv(mem_tests, ms_path("Table3_memory_performance.csv"))
```

# 3. Table S3 — brain score × memory regressions

```{r regressions}
regressions <- expand_grid(LV = params$memory_lvs, outcome = names(outcomes), Group = groups) %>%
  pmap_dfr(function(LV, outcome, Group) {
    df  <- memory_df %>% filter(group_var == Group) %>%
      mutate(brain_score_z = as.numeric(scale(.data[[paste0("usc_", LV)]])))
    fit <- lm(as.formula(paste(outcome, "~ brain_score_z")), data = df)
    co  <- tidy(fit, conf.int = TRUE) %>% filter(term == "brain_score_z")
    tibble(LV, Outcome = outcomes[[outcome]], Group, n = nrow(df),
           b = co$estimate, SE = co$std.error, t = co$statistic,
           df = fit$df.residual, p = co$p.value,
           ci_low = co$conf.low, ci_high = co$conf.high, R2 = glance(fit)$r.squared)
  }) %>%
  mutate(p_fdr = p.adjust(p, method = params$correction_method))

kable(regressions, digits = 3)
write_csv(regressions, supp_path("TableS3_LV2_brainscore_memory.csv"))

ftS3 <- regressions %>%
  transmute(LV, Outcome, Group,
            b = sprintf("%.3f", b), SE = sprintf("%.3f", SE), t = sprintf("%.2f", t), df,
            p = format_pval(p), p_FDR = format_pval(p_fdr),
            `95% CI` = sprintf("[%.3f, %.3f]", ci_low, ci_high), `R²` = sprintf("%.3f", R2)) %>%
  flextable() %>%
  merge_v(j = c("LV", "Outcome")) %>%
  align(j = 4:11, align = "center", part = "all") %>%
  bold(part = "header") %>%
  fontsize(size = 11, part = "all") %>% font(fontname = "Times New Roman", part = "all") %>%
  hline_top(border = fp_border(width = 2), part = "header") %>%
  hline_bottom(border = fp_border(width = 2), part = "body") %>%
  autofit() %>%
  set_caption("Table S3. Within-Group Regression: LV2 Brain Score Predicting Mean Memory Accuracy") %>%
  add_footer_lines(c(
    sprintf(paste0("Note. N = %d after memory-performance exclusion (premenopausal = %d, ",
                   "postmenopausal = %d). Brain score z-scored within each group; outcome = ",
                   "mean accuracy across easy and hard conditions."), nrow(memory_df), n_pre, n_post),
    sprintf("p_FDR: Benjamini-Hochberg correction across %d regressions.", nrow(regressions)),
    "b = unstandardized coefficient (change in accuracy per 1 SD of brain score); CI = 95% confidence interval.")) %>%
  italic(part = "footer") %>% fontsize(size = 10, part = "footer")

ftS3
save_as_docx(ftS3, path = supp_path("TableS3_LV2_brainscore_memory.docx"))
```

# 4. Figure S3 — brain score × memory scatter

```{r figS3, fig.width = 10, fig.height = 6}
scatter_df <- memory_df %>%
  group_by(group_var) %>%
  mutate(across(all_of(paste0("usc_", params$memory_lvs)), ~ as.numeric(scale(.x)))) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  pivot_longer(all_of(paste0("usc_", params$memory_lvs)), names_to = "LV", values_to = "brain_score_z") %>%
  pivot_longer(names(outcomes), names_to = "measure", values_to = "accuracy") %>%
  mutate(LV = sub("usc_", "", LV),
         measure = factor(outcomes[measure], levels = outcomes))

p_figS3 <- ggplot(scatter_df, aes(x = brain_score_z, y = accuracy,
                                  color = group_var, fill = group_var)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.65, size = 2.2) +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = TRUE, alpha = 0.18, linewidth = 0.9) +
  scale_color_manual(values = GROUP_COLORS, name = "Group") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = GROUP_COLORS, name = "Group") +
  facet_grid(measure ~ LV, scales = "free_y", switch = "y") +
  labs(x = "Brain score (z-scored within group)", y = "Mean accuracy") +
  theme_apa(base_size = 12) +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom", strip.background = element_blank(),
        strip.placement = "outside", strip.text = element_text(face = "bold", size = 11))

print(p_figS3)
save_png(p_figS3, supp_path("FigureS3_LV2_brainscore_memory.png"), width = 10, height = 6)
```
